integrity: Universal proof uses explicit elementary simplicial collapses and integral duality; seven finite test cases were run with exact Smith forms. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires connected triangle-free simple graphs with at most two common neighbors per pair and at least eight vertices. Classifies the Alexander-dual homotopy type and the ordinary cut-complex integral homology, not the original cut-complex homotopy type or all possible torsion realizations. Indexed searches cannot eliminate equivalent unindexed theorems.
title: Square-filling theorem for ordinary three-cut complexes of triangle-free graphs
